title: Optimize / Evals 1:1 prep - prompt-set regression & A/B notes
body:
Meeting: 1:1 with Jamie (optimize/evals) - prep notes
Date: 2026-03-04
Goal: align on root cause & short next steps for the recent quality regression flagged by monitoring; agree rollback / mitigations and ownership for follow-ups.

Context / TL;DR:
- On 2026-03-02 our daily evals alerted a regression on prompt_set: customer-support-snippets-v2 (prod traffic routed variant: redwood-open-1.3-q4).
- Metric impact: -3.8% delta on factuality score (eval harness metric: factuality-v2), +6% hallucination rate measured by model-critic, small drop in BLEU (~1.2 pts).
- A/B shows variant B (quantized q4-3) has worse hallucination across shortest-context queries (<128 tokens) vs baseline.
- Hypotheses: kernel selection change in deployment (recent runtime patch 2026-03-01), different kv-cache eviction timing with batching tweak, or quantization-induced numerical drift for certain attention heads.

Agenda (10-15min):
1) Quick sync on what Jamie has repro'd locally / infra signals.
2) Walk through A/B slices (by prompt type, seq_len, customer).
3) Decide immediate mitigation (roll back runtime patch vs pin model to non-quantized variant).
4) Assign owners + deadlines for deeper repro and test harness updates.
5) Decide monitoring/alerting changes if needed.

Notes / data points to surface:
- Repro steps I tried: ran eval harness on latest model artifact with same eval seed (seed=42) - reproduced small drop but magnitude smaller (-1.4%). Could be stochastic or traffic distribution difference.
- Observed bigger deltas on queries containing code blocks and tables.
- Downsampled to short context (<128): effect amplifies. Longer context seems less affected.
- Infra logs: increased cache-eviction events around 2026-03-01 after rolling autoscaler tweak (ticket INF-689). Need Jamie to confirm if runtime kernel selector was toggled in canary.
- PR to runtime: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/789 (kernel selector heuristic change) - rolled 2026-03-01 in canary then to 20% of traffic.

Immediate options (pros/cons):
- Roll back runtime patch (fast to mitigate if it's root cause): + immediate; - requires infra change and rollback playbook + may lose perf improvements.
- Pin affected customers to non-quantized model variant (slower to implement routing but safe): + avoids infra rollback; - adds complexity and cost, longer to enact.
- Re-tune batching/KV eviction config for short-context requests: + surgical; - might not fully resolve numeric drift.

Draft rollback / mitigation plan (what to propose in 1:1):
- If A/B confirms runtime patch at root: rollback runtime patch from canary and pause rollout (owner: infra/release-engineering, contact: Priya).
- Simultaneously pin high-volume biz customers (customer list) to non-quantized fallback for 24-72h (owner: platform-routing team + product).
- Add targeted eval slice to nightly runs for short-context/code-block prompts and raise threshold for auto-alerting (+2% from baseline).

Open questions to resolve in meeting:
- Jamie: can you confirm the canary rollout percentage and kernel selection logs for the window 2026-03-01 -> 2026-03-03?
- Aisha: do we have a fast path to pin routing for 2-3 customers (who saw impact in logs)?
- SRE: is rollback of the runtime patch low-risk given dependent services? (need infra playbook link)
- Repro: what seed and config gave closest magnitude to prod? I got -1.4% with seed=42; prod shows -3.8%. Need to reconcile sampling/traffic mix.

Action items (draft) - short form:
- INF-OWNER (Priya) - check canary rollout logs + be ready to rollback runtime patch if A/B confirms; due EOD 2026-03-04.
- JAMIE PARK - reproduce with full eval harness using production sampling distro for 2026-02-28..2026-03-03 window; add attention/head-level diffs; due 2026-03-05.
- RACHEL WU (me) - add focused short-context/code-block slice to nightly evals and raise watchdog threshold; update alert (EVALS-412) with new metrics; due 2026-03-05.
- AISHA KHAN - check routing pin feasibility and quick routing change docs (platform-runbook); have proposal for pinned fallback by 2026-03-05.
- PLATFORMS/RELEASE - prepare config to pin customers to non-quantized variant for 72h if needed; due 2026-03-06.

Follow-up / sync cadence:
- Quick standup (10 min) tomorrow morning to confirm repro status and infra logs (who: infra, jamie, aisha, me).
- Full post-mortem draft if rollback triggered - owner: me + Jamie, due 1 week after mitigation.

Notes to self / talking points:
- Emphasize we prefer surgical customer pinning over full rollback if available (minimize perf loss).
- Ask for exact traffic slices used in A/B analysis (need percentiles and sampling method).
- Keep runbook of rollback steps handy: link to infra/rollback-playbook (ask Priya to paste during meeting).

Quick links to paste in meeting chat:
- A/B results dashboard: https://analytics.redwood/dashboards/evals/ab/customer-support-snippets-v2
- Eval harness run: gs://redwood-evals/runs/2026-03-03/run-1293/logs
- Runtime PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/789
- Jira: EVALS-412 (alert), INF-689 (autoscaler changes)
